answer: A sybil ring must fund each fake identity with a real stake and real work, but a genuine agent cannot wander across many roles at once: identity reputation accrues only through sustained service, so cloning splits an agents trust and no clone can reach the zenith a dedicated identity can. Cheap forgery collapses because each identity is as distinct as an opal is from a glass imitation, and an attacker who spreads capital thin buys many weak nodes instead of one strong one.
